## Description {#details}

Base class for a deferred reporter that collects messages into a string.

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail/deferred-reporter-base">deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base</Link></code> class serves as the foundational component for deferred reporting within the framework. It is responsible for collecting expectation messages, typically passed via the <code>operator&lt;&lt;()</code>, into a string for later reporting.

This class maintains the result value, abort status, and the source location associated with the report. It is intended exclusively for internal use and is implemented in the <code>include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus</code> folder to ensure a structured and modular codebase.

<ParametersList title="Parameters">

</ParametersList>
This constructor updates the current test suite&#39;s statistics based on the outcome of the test expression. If the evaluated value is true, the count of successful tests is incremented; otherwise, the count of failed tests is incremented. The source location is recorded for reporting purposes, enabling precise identification of the test case within the relevant file or folder.

## Public Destructor

### ~deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base() {#a3a8503e793c807cbb882033cc5ff2831}

<MemberDefinition
  prototype={<>micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::detail::deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base::~deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base ()</>}>
Destructor for the deferred reporter base.

The destructor ensures that if an abort condition is set and the test expression has failed, the test output is flushed and the process is terminated. This mechanism guarantees immediate feedback and halts further execution upon critical test failures, aiding in rapid identification and resolution of issues during test runs.

### operator&lt;&lt;() {#ae90dacdedb65168453056c0787f88567}

<MemberDefinition
  template={<>template &lt;class T&gt;</>}
  prototype={<>auto &amp; micro&#95;os&#95;plus::micro&#95;test&#95;plus::detail::deferred&#95;reporter&#95;base::operator&lt;&lt; (const T &amp; msg)</>}>
Appends a message to the reporter.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type of the message to append.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<ParametersList title="Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="msg">The message to append.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

<SectionUser title="Returns">
Reference to the current reporter instance.
</SectionUser>

This operator overload enables the deferred reporter to accumulate expectation messages by appending the provided value to the internal message string.

If the argument is of an arithmetic type, it is first converted to a string using <code>std::to&#95;string</code> before being appended. For all other types, the value is appended directly. This ensures that both numeric and string-like messages are handled appropriately and consistently.
